note: **Schedules 196 to 199 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** 8 North Road, 7 and 8 Western Terrace, and one household at a number 7 on Cavendish Crescent whose side the index does not give, which is therefore unfiled. The bracket in this batch holds the name the register was written in: Eileen Archer (Almond) is twelve and in her parents' house, which settles it.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
